about: 20 questions for comparing retrieval modes. Each names the article(s) that answer it. 'name' questions hinge on a proper name or rare term; 'paraphrase' questions describe the article in other words, avoiding its title words where possible. Written 11/2026 from the articles themselves, before any mode was run on them.
